Risk Description: Collection, storage, sharing, or secondary use of facial images and identity data may exceed customer expectations or expose sensitive biometric information.
Proposed Mitigation: Complete a DPIA; establish a lawful basis and clear privacy notices; minimise biometric collection; define retention and deletion rules; restrict access; protect biometric templates and assess third-party processors.
Proposed Responsible Owner: Data Protection Officer (DPO) and Information Security
Existing Controls: Not confirmed; verify during implementation review.
Residual Risk: Not assessed; reassess after controls are implemented and tested.

Risk Description: Identity, fraud, or credit models may produce systematically different outcomes across gender, region, or socioeconomic groups, potentially disadvantaging some customers.
Proposed Mitigation: Conduct pre-deployment and ongoing subgroup testing; investigate observed approval and error-rate differences; review data representativeness and influential features; document mitigation decisions; provide appropriate human review and appeal routes.
Proposed Responsible Owner: AI/Model Owner with Risk and Compliance
Existing Controls: Not confirmed; synthetic evaluation provides preliminary diagnostic evidence only.
Residual Risk: Not assessed; synthetic results do not establish real-world fairness.

Risk Description: Customers and staff may not understand why an identity check, transaction, or credit application received a particular outcome, making errors difficult to challenge.
Proposed Mitigation: Document model purpose, limitations, and decision factors; evaluate explanation methods; provide clear customer-facing reasons where appropriate; maintain decision records and escalation procedures.
Existing Controls: Not confirmed; permutation importance was evaluated for the synthetic credit model.
Residual Risk: Not assessed; explanation quality and faithfulness require further validation.

Risk Description: Incorrect model decisions may reject legitimate customers, restrict genuine transactions, approve risky applications, or fail to detect fraudulent activity.
Proposed Mitigation: Set decision thresholds based on documented risk trade-offs; monitor precision, recall, false-positive and false-negative rates; investigate missed fraud cases; use human review and customer appeal processes for consequential decisions.
Existing Controls: Synthetic model evaluation performed; production controls are not confirmed.
Residual Risk: Not assessed; fraud model's synthetic recall was 15.69% and requires substantial investigation before production use.

Risk Description: Customers with limited smartphone access, connectivity, digital literacy, or formal identity documentation may face barriers to onboarding and financial services.
Proposed Mitigation: Assess accessibility across target customer groups; provide suitable assisted or alternative onboarding channels where feasible; design low-bandwidth options; ensure alternative verification and accessible complaint procedures.
Existing Controls: Not confirmed; proposed channels and alternatives require feasibility and security assessment.
Residual Risk: Not assessed; evaluate through user testing and access monitoring.

Risk Description: Unauthorised access, disclosure, alteration, or loss of identity, biometric, transaction, or financial data could harm customers and disrupt services.
Proposed Mitigation: Apply least-privilege access, strong authentication, encryption in transit and at rest, secure key management, logging, vulnerability management, incident response, backups, and third-party security reviews.
Existing Controls: Not confirmed; no security testing evidence supplied.
Residual Risk: Not assessed; requires security testing and control validation.

Risk Description: Over-reliance on automated outputs or unclear responsibilities may allow harmful decisions to proceed without meaningful review, correction, or customer recourse.
Proposed Mitigation: Define accountable model and business owners; introduce risk-based human review; train staff on automation bias; document overrides and escalation; provide customers with accessible dispute and appeal routes.
Proposed Responsible Owner: AI Governance Committee, Business/Model Owners, and Compliance
Existing Controls: Not confirmed; governance arrangements are proposed rather than verified as implemented.
Residual Risk: Not assessed; evaluate review quality, escalation outcomes, and complaint handling.

Risk Description: Power, network, cloud, or third-party service interruptions may delay identity checks, disrupt fraud monitoring, or make financial services unavailable.
Proposed Mitigation: Define safe degraded operating modes; implement resilient infrastructure, backups, recovery procedures, monitoring, and tested incident plans; reconcile transactions after outages; conduct controlled resilience testing.
Existing Controls: Not confirmed; infrastructure resilience evidence was not supplied.
Residual Risk: Not assessed; requires recovery testing and operational monitoring.
